subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

He told his friends / that he is gone/ to visit his parents / in the evening.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'that he is gone'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sentence should be "*He told his friends that he was going to visit his parents in the evening*" as the verb "**told**" is in the past tense and the visit to his parents is also in the past.
 
• The use of "**is gone**" is incorrect as it is present tense and does not match with the past tense of the rest of the sentence.
 
• The correct form should be "**was going**" to match the past tense of "told".
 
• This is an example of a tense agreement error in grammar.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**in the evening**" is a prepositional phrase that correctly describes the time of the visit.
 
• Option 3: "**to visit his parents**" is an infinitive phrase that correctly describes the purpose of the visit.
 
• Option 4: "**He told his friends**" is the subject and verb of the sentence and is correctly placed at the beginning of the sentence.
